# Bundled VCF examples

| File | What it demonstrates |
| --- | --- |
| `dragen-example.g.vcf` | A reference block, phased variants and allele slots in one sample. |
| `dragen-multisample.g.vcf` | Reference sites in two samples, including an observed zero, a zero-depth report and a missing call. |
| `rastair-example.vcf` | Strand and context in the 2.3.0-rc1 format, including an ambiguous de novo allele assignment. |
| `rastair-2.2.0-synthetic.vcf` | Rastair output from simulated reads, including an unsupported record with two CpG contexts in one measurement slot. |

See [the generation scripts and provenance](../scripts/README.md) for
source references, commands and reproduction checks.
